whyThisMatters:
thecontentcook sells recipe books and nutrition guides that are already written. A coach puts their name on the cover and gives the book to a client. Ronan O Brien. Started in November 2024.

The money label is Polar, and Stripe is in the same sync. I am not logging into either one. Twenty-eight subscriptions, and the monthly line is a few hundred. The last thirty days are several times that, and they are down by about a third. The last year is a large share of the all-time total. Margin is claimed at seventy percent, which fits a PDF you made once. The asking price is eighty thousand.

You pay so the meal plan exists on Monday, instead of being written over the weekend.

Nutrition guides sit beside the recipe books. November 2024 is the start. Ronan O Brien is the founder. Seventy percent is the claimed margin. Eighty thousand is the asking price, and the recent month is down.
